exemplar polarity

  • CURIE: gmeow:exemplarPolarity
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarPolarity
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The exemplar's direction. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): an exemplar that cannot say whether to emulate or avoid is just a citation.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Exemplar -> gmeow:ExemplarPolarity; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:exemplarPolarity from gmeow:Exemplar to gmeow:ExemplarPolarity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Exemplar, gmeow:ExemplarPolarity

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to set an exemplar's single direction from the gmeow:ExemplarPolarity vocabulary.

Avoid when

  • Avoid omitting it or giving more than one (it is functional and mandatory — an exemplar without a direction is just a citation).

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:exemplarPolarity once per gmeow:Exemplar; for cautionary exemplars add gmeow:exemplarRedirect to the criterion the passage actually evidences.

Examples

  • ex:ex1 gmeow:exemplarPolarity gmeow:polarityPositive.
